name: External Customer Device Type 1 Code
definition: Specified a type of customer device used for a card payment transaction.||External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

SECR.name: Secure Card Reader
SECR.definition: Card reader device that meets security standards for encrypted PIN entry and secure transaction processing.

NSCR.name: Non Secure Card Reader
NSCR.definition: Card reader without advanced security features, typically used for low-risk or offline transactions.

MOBL.name: Mobile
MOBL.definition: Smartphone used for initiating or receiving transactions, often via apps or NFC.

TBLT.name: Tablet
TBLT.definition: Touchscreen tablet device functioning similarly to a mobile device for payments.

PECR.name: Personal Computer
PECR.definition: Desktop or laptop computer used for online transactions through browsers or installed software.

OTHN.name: Other National
OTHN.definition: Device type specific to a national payment scheme or infrastructure (such as proprietary POS terminals mandated by a country).

OTHP.name: Other Private
OTHP.definition: Proprietary device type used within a private network or closed-loop payment system.

WRBL.name: Wearable
WRBL.definition: Device worn on the body (such as fitness band, smart ring) that supports payment functionality.

VHCL.name: Vehicle
VHCL.definition: In-vehicle system enabling payments (such as tolls, fuel, parking) through embedded technology.

EMBD.name: Embedded
EMBD.definition: Payment-enabled component integrated into another device or appliance.

KFOB.name: Key Fob
KFOB.definition: Small portable device, often used for contactless payments.

JEWL.name: Jewellery
JEWL.definition: Payment-enabled jewelry such as rings or bracelets with NFC or tokenization capabilities.

STIC.name: Sticker
STIC.definition: Payment sticker with embedded NFC or RFID, typically attached to a physical object for tap-and-pay.

GAMB.name: Gaming Device
GAMB.definition: Console or gaming system that supports in-game or digital purchases.

UNKW.name: Unknown
UNKW.definition: Device type cannot be determined or is not disclosed.

TLVN.name: Television
TLVN.definition: Smart TV or connected device enabling payments for streaming or interactive services.

HDST.name: Headless Voice
HDST.definition: Voice-activated device without a screen (e.g., smart speaker) used for initiating transactions.

IOTS.name: Internet Of Things
IOTS.definition: Any IoT-enabled device capable of initiating or receiving payments (e.g., smart fridge ordering groceries).
